name: 79095 · Wellington, TX
findings: ZIP 79095 (Wellington) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79095 (Wellington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79095 (Wellington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
